subject: Post-demo budget clarification and procurement thresholds — BrightLane
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Ortiz <danielle@brightlane.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo budget clarification and procurement thresholds — BrightLane

Hi Danielle,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions from your product and infra teams. Quick recap and a few concrete questions so we can align on next steps: 

Recap of usage scenarios we discussed (ballpark):
- Conservative pilot: ~20M tokens/month (inference-heavy, short prompts)
- Growth ramp: 30–60M tokens/month (mix of chat + embeddings)
- Expansion scenario: 60–120M tokens/month (multiple features + reranking)

Preliminary unit economics (rough internal guidance):
- Target list guidance for a starting quote: $700–$900 per 1M tokens depending on committed volume and caching profiles.
- For the 20M pilot we estimate monthly spend in the $14k–$18k range; for 60M that moves to ~$42k–$54k.

Procurement questions for your team:
1) Budget band confirmation — which of the three bands above is closest to your expected monthly budget for Q4?
2) PO / procurement threshold — do you require a PO for anything above a monthly threshold (e.g., $20k / $25k)? Or does procurement need an annualized contract minimum?
3) Vendor onboarding items — does BrightLane require SOC 2 evidence, a vendor questionnaire, or bank w9/ACH info up front?
4) Timeline — ideal date to finalize a pilot purchase order so we can schedule provisioning.

Attached: BrightLane-MAP.xlsx (your usage mapping from the call) — I dropped the version you shared into the thread with redwood annotations.

Next steps I propose from our side: we can draft a one-page pricing stub and a short SOW for the pilot once you confirm the budget band and procurement expectations. If helpful I can loop in Ben from pricing for a short call to lock the $/1M and any ramp credits.

Thanks — looking forward to making this painless for your procurement team.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: BrightLane-MAP.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Danielle Ortiz <danielle@brightlane.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLane Procurement <procurement@brightlane.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo budget clarification and procurement thresholds — BrightLane

Priyom — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side so you can move forward: 

1) Budget band: current internal target for the pilot is the 30–60M tokens band; finance has put a soft cap of ~$50k/mo for Q4.

2) PO threshold: Procurement requires a PO for ongoing monthly spend > $20k. For pilots we can accept a one-off PO under $20k, but anything expected to sustain or renew needs a standard PO. Annualized minimums are negotiable but preferred where possible.

3) Onboarding requirements: BrightLane requires completion of a short vendor security questionnaire and SOC 2 Type II attestation (or equivalent). We also need bank/W9 details and an internal vendor intake form completed. I attached our onboarding form for your team.

4) Timeline: if we can get a pricing stub and SOW by next Tuesday (21 Sep) procurement can review and queue vendor onboarding; approvals typically take 7–12 business days after intake.

I'll include procurement ops on the PR template once you send a draft PO/quote.

Thanks — Danielle
Danielle Ortiz
Head of Product, BrightLane
danielle@brightlane.io | (617) 555-9191

Subject: Re: Post-demo budget clarification and procurement thresholds — BrightLane

Thanks Danielle — noted on the $50k/mo soft cap and PO > $20k requirement. Looping Ben to confirm we can hit the pricing & PO packaging for the 30–60M band.

Internal note (Priyom / Ben): based on BrightLane's smoothing and expected profile, we can propose the following starter structure to make procurement comfortable while preserving unit economics: 
- Pilot (30–60M): $650 / 1M tokens for first 60 days, then $700 / 1M thereafter if they commit to a 3-month roll; monthly spend estimate ~ $19.5k–$39k depending on consumption.
- Ramp protection: include a 10% credit bucket for cacheable tokens.
- If monthly consistently exceeds $60M, propose Dedicated pricing / reserved capacity (separate quote).

Ben — can you put together a 1-page pricing stub + short SOW draft (pilot objectives, provisioning, success metrics) and attach it here? Also confirm whether we can accept the BrightLane onboarding form as-is or if procurement ops needs additional fields.

Thanks,
Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
